case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for your price and quality proposal and your commitment to reliable supply. Margin protection matters, and we acknowledge that our payment delays have added to your cash pressure.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3). Our demand forecast for this part has changed +20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

We are flexible on the quality commitment: the less demanding option offers more process headroom in exchange for a lower price, while all packages exclude complaint chargebacks. Please choose the option you can reliably deliver; growing demand offers an opportunity to build on measurable improvement.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 43.78 per unit, quality commitment 300 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option B: EUR 43.55 per unit, quality commitment 800 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option C: EUR 43.24 per unit, quality commitment 1500 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.

We value our relationship and want to strengthen it through achievable quality commitments and dependable delivery.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Thanks for the volume boost, that's great news and we can definitely aim for the 1500 ppm target you suggested. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Also, you mentioned the payment delays - if we can get those sorted and paid on time, it really helps us out with our cash flow! Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. To make this work, we can drop the price to €46.00 per unit.

Our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, we can offer a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for reducing your price; we recognise your need to protect margin and how our payment delays aggravate cash pressure. Faster payment is your priority, but this offer leaves payment terms unchanged and makes no binding volume commitment.

We have made a modest price step and are flexible on complaint chargebacks, in exchange for further price movement from you. Option B provides the exclusion of complaint charges you proposed in return for our lowest price; which arrangement works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 44.44 per unit, EUR 500 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option B: EUR 44.30 per unit, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option C: EUR 44.34 per unit, EUR 150 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.

We value our relationship and want an agreement you can sustain while delivering the quality and delivery improvements we need.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

Thanks for the new offer and the price increase, we appreciate it. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Since you are leaving payment terms unchanged and not giving a binding volume, our hands are tied on how much we can drop the price. We can do €46.00 per unit for the 300 ppm and €0 chargeback option, which is a fair compromise from our side. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

So our current Angebot is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Thank you for lowering your price; we recognise that unchanged payment terms and no binding volume commitment limit your room to move. We also acknowledge that our payment delays have added to your cash pressure.

We are making a further modest price step, and the proposed package gives you the complaint-charge exclusion you requested in exchange for further price movement from you. Payment terms remain unchanged, but excluding complaint charges makes your exposure more predictable while retaining the quality commitment you offered.

We propose: EUR 44.55 per unit, quality commitment 300 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.

We value our relationship and look forward to your response, with dependable quality and improved delivery remaining essential.

Kind regards
